subject: Advocate appreciation — pick your thank-you option and logistics
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Advocate appreciation — pick your thank-you option and logistics

Hi Nina —

Thank you again for agreeing to be a customer reference for our upcoming case study. We truly appreciate the time you took on the call last week. As a small token of gratitude, we offer advocates one of the following options — please pick whichever you prefer and reply with any details we need to fulfill it: 

1) Account credit: $150 applied to your Redwood invoice (applies to existing billing account).
2) Charity donation: we donate $150 to a charity of your choice and provide a receipt.
3) Swag pack: curated Redwood kit (hoodie, water bottle, stickers) + $25 credit.

If you choose swag we’ll need a shipping address and t-shirt size. For a donation we’ll need the charity name and (if required) a contact email for the donation receipt. If you want the account credit, confirm the billing account name (or we can apply it to your next invoice).

Also quick question: are you comfortable with a short quote attributed to Nina Patel, VP of Data at Acme Analytics? We’d include it in the case study and may use it on our website and in one-pagers. If yes, any constraints on wording?

No rush — if you can reply by Wednesday that helps us get fulfillment started.

Thanks again,

Kimberly Park
Customer Advocacy Lead | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: advocate-program-options.pdf (summary of options)
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: John Reed <john.reed@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Advocate appreciation — pick your thank-you option and logistics

Hi Kimberly —

Really appreciate the note and the opportunity — happy to help with the case study and a quote is fine. Please attribute it to Nina Patel, VP of Data. A short line about how Redwood helped reduce inference cost and give us predictable latency would be great.

For the thank-you, we’d prefer the donation option. Our team supports literacy initiatives — could you donate to Books for All (EIN: 27-1234567)? If you need a contact, please send it to donations@booksforall.org and cc me (nina.patel@acmeanalytics.com).

Also we’ll need a donation receipt for our records (company name: Acme Analytics, address: 121 Market St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94105). If you could confirm approximate donation date and amount on your end, that would be perfect.

Thanks again — we’ll share the approved quote once you send the draft.

Best,
Nina
Nina Patel
VP of Data | Acme Analytics
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Advocate appreciation — Acme prefers donation to Books for All (need receipt)

Marissa / Ben —

Forwarding Nina’s preference. Please coordinate the donation to Books for All ($150) and generate a donation receipt addressed to Acme Analytics (see address below). Ben, can finance confirm we should book this as a marketing/advocacy expense and issue the receipt? Marissa, once the donation is processed can you drop the signed receipt PDF into the Acme HubSpot company record and loop me?

Donation details (from customer):
- Charity: Books for All
- Contact for receipt: donations@booksforall.org (please CC nina.patel@acmeanalytics.com)
- Donation amount: $150
- Receipt should name: Acme Analytics, 121 Market St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94105

If donation workflows require a PO or internal approval, please advise and I’ll escalate. Would like to close this by EOD Thursday if possible.

Thanks —
Kim

Kim / Marissa —

Finance confirms we can treat this as a marketing/advocacy expense and issue a donation confirmation for $150. I’ve processed the transaction to Books for All and requested a donor receipt from their donations team. Attached is the internal account credit memo for ACME (we applied a $150 advocacy credit as a separate goodwill entry in case the customer needs it for accounting reconciliation).

Marissa — I uploaded the payment confirmation to our internal drive and flagged the HubSpot company record (see link). When Books for All returns the official receipt, please:
- Save the PDF to the HubSpot record
- Email the official receipt to donations@booksforall.org and CC nina.patel@acmeanalytics.com
- Send a confirmation note to Nina from our team with the attached receipt

Attachments: redwood-account-credit-ACME-150-20270512.pdf (internal memo)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: John Reed <john.reed@acmeanalytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Advocate appreciation — pick your thank-you option and logistics

Hi Nina —

Quick update and thanks again: we’ve donated $150 to Books for All on behalf of Acme Analytics. Books for All confirmed the gift and emailed an official donation receipt; I’ve attached the copy to this message for your records. We also created an internal $150 advocacy credit for your account (attached internal memo).

Attached: redwood-donation-receipt-booksforall-20270512.pdf; redwood-account-credit-ACME-150-20270512.pdf

Would you mind reviewing the short quote below and letting us know if any edits are needed? If this looks good we’ll include it in the case study draft: 

"Redwood’s serving runtime let us reliably meet our 99th percentile latency targets while lowering per-token cost — that predictability made it easy to launch our new product feature without infra surprises." — Nina Patel, VP of Data, Acme Analytics

If you’re happy with that attribution, I’ll mark the quote approved and move forward.

Thanks for helping us tell your story — we’ll share the draft with you before publishing.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Customer Advocacy Lead | Redwood Inference
